summary: GRI Bio filed an 8-K under Items 7.01, 8.01 and 9.01 on September 8, 2026, furnishing an updated corporate presentation and a press release announcing new translational biomarker data from the Phase 2a study of GRI-0621 (oral tazarotene) in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural/regulatory mechanic was disclosed. The filing is a routine Regulation FD disclosure and product-development update, not a special situation; the only risk-arb angle is clinical data readout risk on the ongoing Phase 2a program.
